//: Capability manifest for <AppHeader> (the .pc-app-header brand block) — svelte-pure-admin. See section.map.json / footer.map.json for the model. AppHeader.svelte renders <div class="pc-app-header {class}"> around its `children`; with no children it falls back to the config logo + app name (divergent from keen, so the fixture always supplies children). The .pc-app-header__version fit-ladder element is composed by the consumer inside children, not this container — deferred in the fixture, not a feature here. Shared SSR features: the brand slot + the root class passthrough.
